description:
src/lib.rs:78-96 — register_calendars_handlers rustdoc covers what the
function does (registers method names) and what CallerCtx behavior is, but
does NOT cover the silent-overwrite semantics of underlying
Dispatcher::register.

The canonical mail-server's register_mail_handlers at
crate-jmap-mail-server/src/lib.rs:130-146 documents the same primitive
behavior with a # Re-registration semantics section:

    This function calls Dispatcher::register once per RFC 8621 method
    name. Dispatcher::register silently overwrites any pre-existing
    handler under the same method name (the underlying primitive is
    HashMap::insert). Three consequences callers MUST be aware of:

    - Double-call: invoking this function twice on the same
      dispatcher loses the first set's handlers. The second call wins.
    - Custom overrides go LAST: to replace a single handler (e.g.
      provide a custom Email/get), call this function FIRST, then
      dispatcher.register("Email/get", my_override). The inverse order
      silently undoes the custom handler.
    - No collision diagnostic: there is no error or log when a
      handler is overwritten. The contract is "last register wins" and
      the caller is responsible for ordering.

What goes wrong for the caller: a consumer wires their dispatcher like:

    dispatcher.register("Calendar/get", my_custom_calendar_get);
    register_calendars_handlers(&mut dispatcher, backend);
    register_mail_handlers(&mut dispatcher, backend);

…and is surprised when their custom Calendar/get does not run. The
register_calendars_handlers call silently overrode it; the inverse
ordering would work. A consumer who reads only calendars' rustdoc has
no warning of this behavior.

Note: this isn't theoretically dangerous — Dispatcher::register has been
this way since the foundation crate. But the doc-as-contract policy is
that the public API's rustdoc covers its caller-visible behaviors, and
calendars' rustdoc is shorter than mail's by exactly this section.

Fix: mirror the canonical # Re-registration semantics section. Drop in
verbatim, adapt the example method names from Email/* to Calendar/*.
title: register_calendars_handlers rustdoc lacks re-registration semantics warning that canonical documents
